# Keep CSS selectors explicit when child order is not the contract

Use a named class for an account-settings field or control when its role determines layout. In D211687 the author declined first-child/last-child selectors because they assumed exactly two children and a fixed order. Accepted class selectors were kept. This is a scoped rule for those flexible UI groups, not a ban on structural selectors when structure is the contract.

Scope: style CSS selectors.

Paths:

- `mail/themes/shared/mail/accountManage.css`
